open_points.subject: single home and Client Portal exception
open_points.text: “no other service keeps a customer record or a copy of its values, except as fixed in a document it issued” contradicts “Client Portal's offline projection ... is the one kept copy this rule admits besides issued documents”
open_points.question: Is Client Portal's offline projection an issued document covered by the stated exception, or is it a second distinct exception to the single-home rule?
options: Treat the Portal publication as an issued document
Add the Portal projection as a separate exception
Forbid Portal from retaining customer values
open_points.default_guess: Treat the Portal publication as an issued document and state that explicitly.

open_points.subject: single-home guarantee during migration
open_points.text: “Registry is the one home of a customer's personal data” conflicts with “Legacy instances ... hold real personal data” and “Removing the stores and copies the services keep today is each service's own change.”
open_points.question: When does the single-home guarantee begin, and what observable condition proves that legacy instances and existing service stores no longer retain prohibited copies?
options: The guarantee begins only after migration, service cleanup and legacy-data disposal are verified
The guarantee excludes all legacy and pre-vNext copies indefinitely
The product permits dormant retained copies
open_points.default_guess: Make verified cleanup and disposal a production cutover prerequisite.

open_points.subject: Client Portal offline projection contents
open_points.text: “it holds only what the customer's own cabinet shows, never a tax id” does not say which customer values the cabinet shows, while “The customer's contact data reaches the owner alone”
open_points.question: Exactly which Registry values may Client Portal persist in its offline projection, especially customer name, phone, e-mail, language, legal name and object address?
options: Project publication data only, with no customer contact or fiscal values
Customer name and contact values may be included
Any personal_data allowed by Portal's token may be included except tax id
open_points.default_guess: Permit project publication data and object address, but no customer contact or fiscal values.

open_points.subject: billing data disclosure of customer name
open_points.text: “Name, phone, e-mail and language are all the customer's contact data” and “The customer's contact data reaches the owner alone” contradict “read a customer's billing data ... output ... name, kind, tax id, legal name” to PresuPro
open_points.question: May PresuPro receive the customer's name, or is name contact data restricted to the owner?
options: Treat name as billing data for this operation and disclose it to PresuPro
Remove name from the billing-data output
Split contact name from a separately disclosable legal or billing name
open_points.default_guess: Disclose legal name for billing and remove the contact name from PresuPro's output.

open_points.subject: customer erasure after fiscal data moved to Registry
open_points.text: “erase a customer's contact data ... name, phone, e-mail and language are gone” is not updated for “tax id (NIF/NIE/CIF), legal name” even though “The Customer keeps only its identity and the fact that it was erased”
open_points.question: When a Customer is erased, are tax id, legal name, kind, restriction state and relationship-end date also removed, or does any of them survive?
options: Remove every customer value except customer_ref and the erased fact
Remove contact fields but retain fiscal fields
Provide separate contact-data and fiscal-data erasure actions
open_points.default_guess: Remove every customer value except customer_ref and the erased fact.

open_points.subject: agent projection personal-value guarantee
open_points.text: “the minimal projection ... no ... other personal value” and the Agent promise that it “sees each through a minimal projection without personal values” conflict with “a value that breaks it is not refused and does reach the agent” for room names and artifact-pointer values
open_points.question: Is the guarantee about actual personal values reaching the agent, or only about fields Registry formally classifies as personal_data?
options: Guarantee only that classified personal_data fields are excluded
Validate or redact room names and pointer values before agent disclosure
Remove free-text room names and pointer references from the agent projection
open_points.default_guess: State the narrower guarantee explicitly: classified personal_data fields are excluded, while uninspected writer-controlled values remain a documented risk.

open_points.subject: anonymised projects retaining artifact pointers
open_points.text: “An anonymised project keeps its id, status and artifact pointers and nothing else” and “It holds no personal value” conflict with the admission that `uri`, `payload_ref` or digest may contain a personal value and Registry does not inspect or refuse it
open_points.question: What must happen if retained artifact-pointer fields contain or permit re-identification when the owner requests anonymisation?
options: Refuse anonymisation until the owner removes or replaces unsafe pointers
Remove or redact pointers during anonymisation
Keep pointers and do not promise that the result contains no personal value
open_points.default_guess: Refuse anonymisation unless the retained pointer metadata has been confirmed non-identifying.

open_points.subject: authentication bootstrap
open_points.text: “Every request on either is authenticated; anything not authenticated is refused” and “No operation of Registry answers an unauthenticated caller” do not provide the unauthenticated action by which the owner receives and submits the sign-in form
open_points.question: Which unauthenticated requests are allowed to establish the owner's authenticated session, and what do they return or refuse?
options: Allow only the sign-in form and credential-submission endpoint unauthenticated
Use authentication outside Registry before any owner-interface request
Require client-certificate or HTTP authentication so no Registry login action is needed
open_points.default_guess: Allow only the sign-in page and credential submission as explicit authentication-bootstrap exceptions.

open_points.subject: projects admitted by the one-time VPS import
open_points.text: “the projects the owner picks” and “today [two named projects]” do not say whether those two projects are the fixed import set or merely the current selection from an arbitrary VPS catalogue
open_points.question: May the owner select any VPS projects at import time, or must production accept exactly the two named project ids?
options: Import exactly the two named project ids
Allow the owner to select any subset from the VPS export
Allow those two by default but permit an explicit reviewed override
open_points.default_guess: Fix the migration to exactly the two named project ids.
